stage2.usage: exact SVG silhouette sources used only as alpha masks; no path/viewBox/transform edits

stage3.preservation: Stage 4 reuses the same locked neutral-reference RGB pixels at the same source scale, so frozen face/hair pixels are unchanged rather than repainted or transformed.

buildMethod.neutralViews: Reuse each locked Stage 1 neutral reference image at exact source dimensions; clip only with the corresponding frozen Stage 2 silhouette alpha mask.
buildMethod.identityProtection: No face/hair-specific operation exists in Stage 4; the exact source pixels previously frozen by Stage 3 remain the source of truth.
buildMethod.detailAuthority: Reuse REF-DETAIL at 1:1 as the local detail atlas; no generative redraw, lighting change, recolor or synthetic glow pass.

appearanceContract.costume: fitted black/graphite high-fashion operator tailoring; high collar; long coat tails; smoked/sheer technical panels; major seams from locked references
appearanceContract.core: diamond CYBOARD signal/chest core; cyan center with restrained violet/magenta framing
appearanceContract.emissive: restrained cyan/violet/selective magenta; reference-derived only; no bloom added beyond locked source
appearanceContract.handsGloves: locked fitted-glove/hand appearance from neutral views plus REF-DETAIL authority
appearanceContract.footwear: locked heeled ankle-boot appearance from neutral views plus REF-DETAIL authority
appearanceContract.detailDensity: locked source hierarchy retained at hero inspection scale and checked at 96 px character height

freezeAfterPass: restrained emissive placement and relative intensity
deferred: deformable layer/mesh segmentation topology belongs to Stage 5
